aline: Heads-up 1: I opened a docs PR for handling prompt truncation + 429 recovery patterns. Targets: troubleshooting guide, the JS/Python SDK snippets, and a short console UX blurb. Preview: https://staging.docs.redwood/preview/pt-trunc-429-recovery

noah: Nice. Does this change the recommended order of operations for a truncated prompt? We currently suggest a hard truncate then fail.

aline: New guidance: try to return a safe partial result when possible (partial_output flag), then attempt a trimmed retry (drop oldest context) with quick backoff. If 429 persists, switch to a compatible fallback model or degraded latency tier. Flow chart included in PR.

pattie: Can you paste the minimal JS example here so I can smoke test? Also note SDK v2 renamed some args in the last release.

aline: JS example (minimal):
```js
// graceful return + trimmed-retry + fallback
const resp = await client.generate({
  model: 'rwd-large-v1',
  prompt: autoTrim(originalPrompt, {mode: 'drop_old', keep_tokens: 1200}),
  backoff: {strategy: 'expo', base_ms: 200, max_tries: 2},
  on_partial: (p) => console.warn('partial output', p.length),
  fallback: {model: 'rwd-medium-v1'}
});
```

noah: For the SDK rename: old `keep_context` -> new `keep_tokens`; old `retry` -> `backoff`. Add a small compatibility table in the migration note.

pattie: Python example please? Also include a sample response so product can wire an alert.

aline: Python sample + example response:
```py
# trimmed retry + fallback
r = client.generate(
  model='rwd-large-v1',
  prompt=auto_trim(prompt_text, mode='drop_old', keep_tokens=1200),
  backoff={'strategy':'expo','base_ms':200,'max_tries':2},
  fallback={'model':'rwd-medium-v1'}
)
# example response metadata
# {"partial_output": true, "truncated": true, "truncation_reason": "context_overflow", "returned_tokens": 300, "original_tokens": 1400}
```

docs-bot: Preview created: https://staging.docs.redwood/tickets/9225. Please run `npm run docs-lint` and `make docs-check`.

noah: Product asks for a console banner when truncation occurs: include token counts and a link to the request trace. Metric names suggested: `truncation.count`, `truncation.tokens_dropped`, and a boolean `response.partial_output`.

aline: I'll add a short UX note recommending an unobtrusive in-console banner and a diagnostic link. Also adding the metric names and a sample trace JSON in the appendix.

pattie: CI note: the JS snippet uses `autoTrim` helper we don't export from SDK. Can we show the small helper inline in docs or change to using `client.trimPrompt(...)`?

aline: Good catch. I'll replace the helper with `client.trim_prompt` in docs to match public API.

noah: Also add a small migration note for teams on runtime <=1.7: behavior for partial outputs was different (they were dropped silently). Recommend testing prompt expiry and enabling `partial_output` in telemetry.

pattie: I ran the JS sample locally against staging and got a 429 on the first try, trimmed retry succeeded. I'll paste the trace after lunch.

aline: ACTIONS: @aline update snippets to use public API + add sample response JSON; @noah add metric and trace examples; @pattie paste trace and verify console banner wording; I'll iterate preview and merge once lint & CI are green.

docs-bot: CI link: https://ci.redwood/builds/4602. Reminder: docs PR must include smoke test logs.

aline: Thanks all. Plan to merge tomorrow AM if CI green. Merge will also create a backport PR to the legacy docs set.
